predecessors.name: Teotihuacan
predecessors.text: Tula area: 'The area probably was under the political control of Teotihuacan in the Epiclassic period.'

ledger.x: 875: the Tula Chico state at Tula, the seed of the Toltec.
900: Tula Grande rises and the Toltec sphere spreads over most of Hidalgo.
1150: Tula falls to Chichimec peoples and is abandoned.

wars.name: Chichimec conquest of Tula
wars.outcome: Tula was burned and abandoned in the 12th century; the Toltec page names 'Arrival of Chichimec peoples who conquered Tula' as the cause of collapse.

certainty.note: Archaeological sphere of a regional state; the extent is only 'thought to include most of the present state of Hidalgo'.
